tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.title: Get wallet balances
tools.description: Get the signed-in member's Hustlers Fund wallet: total savings/contributions, outstanding petrol and personal loan balances, emergency contributions and joining fee status.

tools.name: get_account_statement
tools.title: Get account statement
tools.description: Get the signed-in member's mini statement: a chronological ledger of contributions, loans, repayments and interest with running savings and loan balances.

limit.description: Maximum number of most recent entries to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: get_loan_history
tools.title: Get loan history
tools.description: List the signed-in member's petrol and personal loans with amount, interest, status, outstanding balance and due date.

type.description: Filter to one loan type. Omit to return both.

status.description: Filter to a single loan status.

tools.name: get_payment_history
tools.title: Get payment history
tools.description: List the signed-in member's submitted weekly contributions and other payments, with amounts, method, verification status and the cycle they belong to.

status.description: Filter to a single payment status.

limit.description: Maximum payments to return. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: get_current_cycle
tools.title: Get current contribution cycle
tools.description: Get the open weekly contribution cycle (dates and deadline), the standard contribution amounts, and whether the signed-in member has already paid for it.
